outcome: Maternal and umbilical cord blood (UCB) humoral and cellular immunity
cohort: 79 pregnant women delivering after the diagnosis of SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy
finding: Although SARS-CoV-2 RNA was not detected in placental samples, a significant immune response was transmitted to the fetus in cases of maternal SARS-CoV-2 infection, as evidenced by detectable levels of IgG antibodies and cytokines in UCB and correlations between UCB IgG concentrations and fetal lymphocyte subsets.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery 39.1 weeks
